_note: Item constraint fixtures for the optimiser (P0-T10). Each entry maps to an `item_constraints` row (see crates/core/src/domain.rs::ItemConstraints) for a household canonical item. `allowed_brands`, `excluded_brands` and `dietary_flags` are stored but NOT enforced in Phase 0 (Backlog-T1); only `brand` (under constraint_policy='brand') and `preferred_size_*` (±20% band) are enforced. The Fairy entry is the brand-constrained example required by the issue: with policy='brand' and brand='Fairy', own-label washing-up liquid is excluded and only Fairy products are priced.
